Based on my search, the role of Noah Newman on *The Young and the Restless* is currently played by **Lucas Adams**, who made his debut on November 4, 2025. He is the latest in a long line of actors to portray this character.

## Past Actors Who Played Noah Newman:

| Actor | Years |
|-------|-------|
| Hunter Allan | 2005–2008 |
| Kevin Schmidt | 2008–2010; 2011–2012 |
| Luke Kleintank | 2010–2011 |
| Robert Adamson | 2012–2018; 2020 (various guest stints) |
| Rory Gibson | 2021–2023 |
| **Lucas Adams** | **2025–present** |

Lucas Adams is best known to soap fans for his previous role as Tripp Dalton on *Days of Our Lives* (2017–2024), where he earned two Daytime Emmy nominations. Interestingly, this isn't his first appearance on *The Young and the Restless*—he made a brief one-episode appearance in March 2012 as a character named Wesley, which was actually his first-ever speaking role on television.

Adams took over the role after Rory Gibson left *Y&R* in 2023 to join *General Hospital* as Michael Corinthos. Noah Newman is the son of supercouple Nick Newman (Joshua Morrow) and Sharon Newman (Sharon Case), making him an important legacy character in the Newman family.
